purpose.restart_centering: center10 versus center1 within each metric policy
purpose.window_schedule: boundary-aligned step and dual-state jumps in adaptive cells versus the no-window fixed-metric controls
purpose.acceptance_noise: paired current level0-error and accepted-trajectory acceptance streams on the same transitions
purpose.metric_coupling: adaptive versus fixed metric within each centering policy, including cross-chain mass/step correlations

warmup_transition: step before transition and instantaneous step after dual update
current adaptation statistic or missing reason
number, mean, variance, minimum and maximum of leaf adaptation values
stop reason, divergence, refinement attempts and reverse-coarser rejections
dual_averaging_checkpoint: iteration, target, mu, h_bar, log_step, log_step_bar
metric_checkpoint: mass diagonal before and after update
step before metric update, after optional search, after restart
generic_instrumentation.storage: warmup-only typed telemetry; no tracing or allocation during retained sampling

mechanism_rules.restart_centering_supported: center10 reduces median log step max-minus-min by at least log(2), has step ratio <=4 on every seed, and improves median dispersed-start scale ESS/target-call by >=1.25 without any seed below 0.8
mechanism_rules.window_instability_supported: at least 50% of total absolute log-step movement occurs within 16 transitions after metric-window boundaries in adaptive but not fixed cells
mechanism_rules.acceptance_noise_supported: current versus accepted-trajectory statistic correlation <0.5 or current statistic missing/rejection-conditioned rate differs by >=0.20
mechanism_rules.metric_coupling_supported: adaptive-minus-fixed cross-chain log-step dispersion is >=log(2) and correlates |rho|>=0.7 with log mass scale in at least two seeds
mechanism_rules.advancement: advance only center10 if its adaptive cells pass health/feasibility on all seeds and restart_centering_supported; otherwise no sampler change
mechanism_rules.falsification: if center10 does not meet the preregistered dispersion and efficiency effects, reject restart centering as the primary cause

resource_policy.partial_failure: preserve attempt, classify failed cell as resource evidence, make advancement impossible
resource_policy.preflight: 12 seed-by-cell dispatches compile and start zero target callbacks against walnutpie-warmup-telemetry-tau0.6-m1-r2-e1-d3-v7

matched_numpyro_reference.behavior: find reasonable step after metric-window updates, initialize dual averaging with mu=log(10*step), reset dual state, and use trajectory acceptance probability
